description: Noisy selection: capacity and residual-capacity selection from Pauli values measured with finitely many shots; shots needed to reach the target accuracy (S*) and the shot ratio including the selection measurement.
author: the authors

params.noise_model: E_sel = E_tr + N(0, 3^w / S_sel), terimler ve noktalar arasi bagimsiz (gate4_core.noisy_features ile ayni)
params.kernel: RAW: gurultulu ozelliklerin kosinusu; S=inf gurultusuz
params.cost: oran = S*_hbody / (S*_kol(S_sel) + f * S_sel), f = egitim payi (~0.7); S_sel=inf -> secim maliyetsiz
